title: juicy show-off jamaican cheese bake
description: a show-stopping jamaican dish featuring stilton cheese and a mirepoix base, perfect for a special occasion or dinner party.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Add the pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, allspice, and thyme to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pork, cooked vegetables, and Stilton cheese. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with chopped green onions and cilantro.
Bake the cheese bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the cheese bake hot, garnished with additional chopped green onions and cilantro if desired.
